summary: NervGen Pharma Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the TSX and NYSE American, furnished a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026 reporting an auditor change effective September 15, 2026. KPMG Canada resigned at the company's request and KPMG US was appointed to serve until the next annual shareholder meeting, with both the audit committee and board approving the change. The filing asserts no modified opinions and no reportable events over the prior two fiscal years, so this is a routine governance disclosure rather than a special situation.
